strings.Select every download in this list (clic: 选择此列表中的所有下载(再次点击取消选择)
strings.Remove the selected downloads from the l: 从列表中移除所选下载
strings.Remove finished downloads from the list: 从列表中移除已完成的下载
strings.Download files from a website section: 下载网站某个部分的文件
strings.Click Add URL, paste a link, drop one on: 点击“添加网址”,粘贴链接,将链接拖到此窗口,或通过扩展从浏览器下载。
strings.Delete and Move File to Recycle Bin…: 删除并将文件移到回收站…
strings.Delete and Move File to Trash…: 删除并将文件移到废纸篓…
strings.The new language is used after the app r: 新语言会在应用重启后使用。
strings.Downloads, videos and torrents use only: 下载、视频和种子只使用此适配器（例如你的 VPN）。如果它断开，下载会停止，而不会改用其他连接。
strings.Torrent blocklist: a file or an https://: 种子屏蔽列表：文件或 https:// 地址（留空 = 无）
strings.Torrents never connect to the addresses: 种子永远不会连接此列表中的地址。支持 P2P、DAT 和 CIDR 列表，也支持 .gz。地址每天重新下载一次。
strings.The blocklist address must start with ht: 屏蔽列表地址必须以 https:// 开头
strings.New items of these feeds are downloaded: 这些订阅源的新条目在标题符合规则时自动下载：文件和视频，开启种子后也包括种子。规则是标题中必须全部出现的词，或 /正则表达式/。
strings.Feed address (RSS or Atom): 订阅源地址（RSS 或 Atom）
strings.Download items whose title has all of th: 下载标题包含以下全部词语的条目（留空 = 全部）
strings.Skip items whose title has any of these: 跳过标题包含以下任一词语的条目
strings.Only download items that appear after th: 只下载添加订阅源之后出现的条目
strings.The feed address must start with http://: 订阅源地址必须以 http:// 或 https:// 开头
strings.The rule's regular expression is not val: 规则的正则表达式无效。
strings.While I use the computer, limit download: 我使用电脑时，将下载限制为 KB/s（0 = 关闭）
strings.Full speed again after a minute without: 一分钟没有键盘或鼠标操作后恢复全速。
strings.Your API key for the service: 你的服务 API 密钥
strings.Sites whose links go through it (comma s: 经由该服务的网站（用逗号分隔，例如 example-host.com）
strings.Off by default. Uses your own account; l: 默认关闭。使用你自己的账户；其他网站的链接绝不会发送给该服务。密钥加密保存，不会进入备份。
strings.Download limit: at most this many MB (0: Download limit: at most this many MB (0 = no limit)
strings.When the amount is reached, downloads st: When the amount is reached, downloads stop and continue by themselves when the next period starts.
strings.Enter the proxy script's web address (ht: Enter the proxy script's web address (http:// or https://) or the full path of the file.
strings.Proxy address (for a proxy script: its w: Proxy address (for a proxy script: its web address or file)
strings.Put each package in its own folder: Put each package in its own folder
strings.Unpack a package's archives when all of: Unpack a package's archives when all of it is done
strings.Paste text with links, or a web page add: Paste text with links, or a web page address and press Find Links. Parts of a split archive are grouped into one package.
strings.Save the whole gallery with the gallery: Save the whole gallery with the gallery engine (sites like Reddit, Pixiv, DeviantArt, Imgur; the engine is downloaded the first time)
strings.Start the Add window in the folder I use: Start the Add window in the folder I used last time
strings.Wake the computer from sleep to start: Wake the computer from sleep to start
strings.Uses a Windows wake timer; Power Options: Uses a Windows wake timer; Power Options must allow wake timers. The app has to be running (it can be in the tray).
strings.Getting the gallery engine (only the fir: Getting the gallery engine (only the first time)…
strings.Getting the video engine (only the first: Getting the video engine (only the first time)…
strings.KiB, MiB, GiB (1 KiB = 1024 bytes): 千兆字节(1千兆字节=1024字节)
strings.Converting needs FFmpeg. MP3 uses the be: 转换需要FFmpeg。 MP3使用最好的可变质量;FLAC保留网站发送的声音的每一个细节。
strings.Downloads I resume myself: run this many: 下载 我重复自己:在队列旁边同时运行这么多(0 = 等待队列插槽)
strings.When the app starts, remove finished dow: 当应用程序启动时,删除文件已删除或移动的已完成下载
strings.Settings, the download list and unfinish: 设置、下载列表和未完成的部分保留在
strings.The data moves the next time the app sta: 下次启动应用程序时,数据将被移动。 在删除旧副本之前,所有内容都将被复制并检查。
选择完整的文件夹路径。
strings.Choose a folder that is not inside the c: 选择不在当前数据文件夹内的文件夹(反之亦然 ) 。
strings.Put a range in square brackets: [001-100: 在方括号中放入一个范围:[001-100]保留三位数字,[1-100]不保留,[a-z]使用字母,[0-100:5]以五位数计数。 括号中的列表,{jpg,png }, 尝试每个值。
strings.Words find links that contain them; * an: 单词会找到包含它们的链接; * 和? 是通配符;! 排除链接。 例如: *. jpg! * thumb *
strings.Links to download (you can edit them): 下载链接(您可以编辑它们)
